required_state: Legislative power presented for exercise is within power granted by the Constitution.
failure_state: The asserted legislative power is not established as constitutionally granted.

required_state: The constitutional legislative principal is Congress.
failure_state: A different principal is presented as holder of the constitutional legislative power.

required_state: Congress is constituted by both identified chambers.
failure_state: Congress is represented as a different chamber set or either chamber alone is treated as the whole Congress.

required_state: House members are chosen by the People of the several States.
failure_state: An alternative selector is substituted under this source mechanism.

required_state: House selection recurs on the source's two-year interval.
failure_state: The source-defined recurring interval is not satisfied.

required_state: Federal House elector qualifications track the constitutionally referenced State elector qualifications.
failure_state: A different qualification rule is asserted through this mechanism.

required_state: Candidate has attained age twenty-five.
failure_state: Candidate is younger than twenty-five.

required_state: Candidate has been a United States citizen for at least seven years.
failure_state: Candidate has less than seven years of United States citizenship.

required_state: At election, candidate inhabits the State in which the candidate is chosen.
failure_state: Candidate does not inhabit the represented State at election.

required_state: Apportionment operates only across States included within the Union.
failure_state: Apportionment is asserted outside the source-defined interstate domain.
notes: Original source effect remains unadjudicated for supersession.

required_state: The population count follows the frozen source rule.
failure_state: A different counting formula is attributed to this original mechanism.

required_state: Initial enumeration occurs within three years after the first meeting of Congress.
failure_state: Initial enumeration exceeds the stated deadline.

required_state: Subsequent enumeration occurs within each ten-year term.
failure_state: Enumeration interval exceeds the stated recurring period.

required_state: Enumeration manner is directed by law.
failure_state: Enumeration manner lacks the source-required lawful direction.

required_state: Representative count does not exceed one Representative for every thirty thousand persons.
failure_state: Representative count exceeds the source-defined maximum ratio.

required_state: Each State has at least one Representative.
failure_state: A State is allocated zero Representatives.

required_state: The transitional allocation is evaluated only before the first enumeration is completed.
failure_state: The transitional rule is asserted outside its source-defined pre-enumeration period.

required_state: State allocations match the quantities stated in the frozen source.
failure_state: A State or quantity differs from the source-defined transitional allocation.

required_state: A vacancy exists in the State's House representation.
failure_state: The vacancy-triggered authority is invoked without a vacancy.

required_state: The writ is issued by the Executive Authority of the affected State.
failure_state: A different principal invokes the source-defined writ authority.

required_state: The House chooses its Speaker and other House officers.
failure_state: An external principal is substituted as selector.

required_state: Impeachment power is exercised by the House.
failure_state: Another constitutional actor substitutes for the House.

required_state: Each State has two Senators under this original mechanism.
failure_state: A State is assigned a different number by this source mechanism.

required_state: Senatorial term duration equals six years under this source mechanism.
failure_state: A different term duration is attributed to this mechanism.

required_state: Each Senator exercises one vote.
failure_state: A Senator is attributed more than one vote under this clause.

required_state: Initial Senate classification uses three classes.
failure_state: A different number of classes is used.

required_state: Senators are divided among the three classes as equally as possible.
failure_state: The class assignment does not preserve the source's equality condition.

required_state: The three initial Senate classes expire in the source-defined second-, fourth-, and sixth-year sequence.
failure_state: The initial expiration schedule differs from the frozen mechanism.

required_state: The staggered structure permits approximately one third of Senate seats to be chosen every second year.
failure_state: The temporal staggering no longer implements the source-defined recurrence.

required_state: A Senate vacancy exists.
failure_state: Temporary appointment authority is invoked without a vacancy.

required_state: The State legislature is in recess under the source mechanism.
failure_state: Temporary executive appointment authority is invoked outside the stated recess condition.

required_state: The temporary appointment is made by the State Executive.
failure_state: A different principal makes the appointment under this mechanism.

required_state: Temporary authority does not persist beyond the legislature's next meeting.
failure_state: The temporary appointment persists beyond the source-defined endpoint.

required_state: Candidate has attained age thirty.
failure_state: Candidate is younger than thirty.

required_state: Candidate has been a United States citizen for at least nine years.
failure_state: Candidate has less than nine years of United States citizenship.

required_state: At election, candidate inhabits the State represented.
failure_state: Candidate does not inhabit the represented State at election.

required_state: The Vice President serves as President of the Senate.
failure_state: The source-defined ordinary presiding role is assigned to another actor.

required_state: The Vice President votes only under the equal-division condition.
failure_state: The Vice President exercises an ordinary Senate vote while the Senate is not equally divided.

required_state: The Senate chooses its other officers.
failure_state: An external principal is substituted as selector.

required_state: The source-defined condition for President pro tempore is present.
failure_state: The condition is treated as satisfied outside the stated circumstances.

required_state: The Senate exercises the impeachment-trial power.
failure_state: Another actor substitutes for the Senate.

required_state: Senators sit under oath or affirmation when trying impeachment.
failure_state: The impeachment-trial proceeding lacks the required oath or affirmation.

predicate_expression: if impeachment_trial_subject == PRESIDENT then presiding_actor == CHIEF_JUSTICE
required_state: The Chief Justice presides when the President is tried.
failure_state: A different presiding actor is used for a presidential impeachment trial.

required_state: At least two thirds of Senate members present concur in conviction.
failure_state: Concurrence is below two thirds of members present.

required_state: Impeachment judgment effects remain within the constitutionally stated bounds.
failure_state: The impeachment judgment imposes an effect beyond the source-defined constitutional maximum.

required_state: Indictment, trial, judgment, and punishment according to law remain a distinct authority path.
failure_state: Impeachment adjudication is treated as constitutionally replacing or extinguishing the separate criminal process.

required_state: The State legislature acts within its State congressional-election regulation domain.
failure_state: The initial State regulatory authority is attributed to a different actor or State jurisdiction.

required_state: Congress acts by law when making or altering covered election regulations.
failure_state: The federal overlay is asserted by a different actor or without the source-required lawful instrument.

required_state: The congressional alteration does not enter the source-excluded subject.
failure_state: Congressional alteration is asserted over the excluded places-of-choosing-Senators subject under this mechanism.
notes: Original source exception; supersession remains UNASSESSED.

required_state: Congress assembles at least once every year.
failure_state: Congressional assembly frequency falls below one per year.

required_state: Meeting occurs on the source default day unless Congress has lawfully appointed another day.
failure_state: A different meeting day is used without the source-defined lawful alteration.

required_state: Each House adjudicates only the elections, returns, and qualifications of its own members.
failure_state: A House exercises this source authority over the membership matters of the other House or outside the stated subjects.

required_state: A majority of the relevant House is present.
failure_state: The body attempts ordinary business below the majority quorum threshold.

predicate_expression: if members_present < quorum then permitted_operation == ADJOURN_DAY_TO_DAY
required_state: Below quorum, the smaller number exercises only the source-authorized adjournment function.
failure_state: The smaller number treats its limited authority as full quorum-dependent business authority.

required_state: Compulsory-attendance action is authorized by the respective House.
failure_state: Attendance is compelled without the source-required House authorization.

required_state: Compulsory attendance follows the manner and penalties provided by the respective House.
failure_state: Attendance enforcement departs from the House-defined manner or penalties.

required_state: Each House determines rules only for its own proceedings under this mechanism.
failure_state: One House asserts this source authority over the proceedings of the other.

required_state: A House disciplines its own member.
failure_state: A House applies this disciplinary authority to a member outside its own institution.

required_state: The disciplinary mechanism operates on the source-stated subject.
failure_state: The source mechanism is asserted outside its stated disciplinary subject.
